title: Command Center fleet node Setup (provider seats)
description: Opens the fleet map, dismisses What's new, opens the quiet per-machine Setup control, and asserts the node-setup modal lists compact runner seats (bind/ambient + optional CodexBar identity/quota) without dumping detail into the fleet header.

open-fleet.intent: Show the operator fleet map with machine groups and a quiet Setup control per node.

dismiss-whats-new.intent: Clear the What's new overlay so fleet machine controls stay clickable.

wait-setup-button.intent: Confirm each machine group exposes a compact Setup control once seats have loaded.

open-setup-modal.intent: Open node setup as a modal so subscription detail stays off the fleet chrome.

wait-setup-modal.intent: Confirm the Setup modal shows Node setup and the codex seat for this host.

assert-runner-seats.intent: Confirm the seat list also covers Claude and Cursor without filling the machine header.

capture-setup-modal.label: Fleet machine Setup modal with compact runner seats
capture-setup-modal.note: Reviewer evidence: quiet Setup button, modal node setup, one-line seats
capture-setup-modal.intent: Record reviewer-visible proof of the cleaner node Setup modal UX.
